summary: WeShop Holdings Ltd, a BVI-incorporated foreign private issuer whose Class A ordinary shares are registered in the US, furnished a Form 6-K attaching its Notice of 2026 Annual General Meeting, proxy statement and form of proxy (Exhibits 99.1 and 99.2). The AGM will be held October 16, 2026 at 11:00 a.m. BST at JTC House, St Helier, Jersey, with a record date of 9:00 p.m. BST September 25, 2026. The board recommends a vote FOR Items 1 and 2, which are not specified as special-situation matters in the excerpt. No transaction terms, advisor, or deal mechanics are disclosed; this is a routine meeting notice and proxy solicitation, equivalent to a US annual meeting proxy, not a special situation.
